legend.priority: P1: release blocker if it fails. P2: must be fixed before the next release. P3: fix when convenient.
legend.suite: api | smoke | regression | slow (long waits, run on demand)

testCases.title: Health endpoint reports ok
testCases.expected: Status 200 and body {"status":"ok"}

testCases.title: Every operation in the OpenAPI document is exercised by the API suite
steps: Compare with the operation map of the API suite
testCases.expected: 27 documented operations, 0 without an API test

testCases.title: Public config and robots endpoints respond
testCases.expected: Both return 200; config has a flags array; robots.txt contains 'Disallow: /'

testCases.title: Register with a well-formed email and an 8+ character password
steps: POST /api/auth/register with a unique email and password 'eventpass123'
testCases.expected: Status 200, role CUSTOMER, email echoed, phone null

testCases.title: Register rejects a malformed email
testCases.expected: Both return 400; no account is created

testCases.title: Register rejects a 7 character password
testCases.expected: Status 400 with a message naming the 8 character minimum

testCases.title: Register accepts an 8 character password
testCases.expected: Status 200

testCases.title: Register phone length boundaries (9 rejected, 10 and 15 accepted, 16 rejected)
testCases.expected: 400, 200, 200, 400 respectively

testCases.title: Register rejects a phone made of letters
testCases.expected: Status 400; phone must be digits

testCases.title: Register refuses an email that is already registered
testCases.expected: Second call returns 409 'Email already registered'

testCases.title: Register refuses the same email in different letter case
testCases.expected: Status 409

testCases.title: Register refuses the same email with surrounding spaces
testCases.expected: Status 400 or 409; no second account

testCases.title: Login returns an HttpOnly session cookie and /me identifies the user
testCases.expected: Cookie 'token' with HttpOnly and Secure; /me returns 200 with the same email

testCases.title: Login with a wrong password is refused
testCases.expected: Status 401 'Incorrect email or password'; no cookie set

testCases.title: Session token lifetime is 30 minutes
testCases.expected: exp - iat = 1800 seconds

testCases.title: Logout ends the session
testCases.expected: Logout 200; /me 401

testCases.title: Login-only endpoints refuse anonymous callers
testCases.expected: Every call returns 401

testCases.title: A session older than 30 minutes is refused
testCases.expected: Status 401

testCases.title: Profile phone update with 10 digits
testCases.expected: 200 both; phone is '0912345678'

testCases.title: Profile phone update rejects 9 and 16 digits
testCases.expected: Both 400

testCases.title: Profile phone update rejects letters
testCases.expected: Status 400; stored phone unchanged

testCases.title: Password change takes effect for the next login
testCases.expected: Change 200; old password 401; new password 200

testCases.title: Password change with a wrong current password is refused
testCases.expected: Status 400 'Current password is incorrect'

testCases.title: New password equal to the current one is refused
steps: POST /api/profile/password with current P and new P
testCases.expected: Status 400

testCases.title: New password of 7 characters is refused
testCases.expected: Status 400

testCases.title: Listing is paginated at 10 per page with a total
testCases.expected: 10 items, pageSize 10, page 1, total equals the pageSize=100 count

testCases.title: Event detail offers Standard, VIP and Student
testCases.expected: Exactly three ticket types named STANDARD, VIP, STUDENT with price and remaining

testCases.title: Unknown event id returns 404
testCases.expected: Status 404

testCases.title: Search 'rock' returns Hanoi Rock Fest (any part of the name)
testCases.expected: 'rock' result contains 'Hanoi Rock Fest'; 'fest' result contains every title with 'fest' in it

testCases.title: Search ignores letter case
testCases.expected: Same non-empty set of ids

testCases.title: Search treats % and _ as literal text
testCases.expected: Both return total 0

testCases.title: Venue filter returns the exact venue
testCases.expected: Every item has venue exactly 'Hanoi Opera House'; at least one item

testCases.title: Venue filter does not match partial or differently cased venues
testCases.expected: Both total 0

testCases.title: Sort by name covers the whole list
testCases.expected: Each page equals the matching slice of the full list sorted alphabetically; page 1 opens with 'Autumn Symphony Night'

testCases.title: Sort by date is ascending over the whole list
testCases.expected: Concatenated pages are in ascending startsAt order

testCases.title: Paging through the list shows each event exactly once
testCases.expected: No duplicate id, no missing id, count equals total

testCases.title: pageSize boundaries 0 and 101 rejected, 1 and 100 accepted
Events that already started are marked PAST
testCases.expected: status PAST exactly for events whose start is before now

testCases.title: Adding one Standard ticket prices the cart per the spec
testCases.expected: gross = price, discount 0, serviceFee = 5% of price, total = 105% of price

testCases.title: Quantity 0 is refused
testCases.expected: Add returns 400; cart has no items

testCases.title: Negative quantity is refused and the total never goes below zero
testCases.expected: Add returns 400; cart total is 0

testCases.title: Fractional quantity is refused
testCases.expected: Status 400

testCases.title: Unknown ticket type is refused
testCases.expected: Status 404 'Ticket type not found'

testCases.title: Hold expiry is 10 minutes after the most recent add
steps: Add Standard 1 and note the server Date header
testCases.expected: holdExpiresAt is 10 minutes after each add (tolerance 5 s) and moves forward with the second add

testCases.title: Changing a line quantity reprices the cart
testCases.expected: gross = 3 x price; totals match the oracle

testCases.title: Mixed cart without discount shows the fee on its own line
testCases.expected: serviceFee = 5% of gross; total = gross + serviceFee

testCases.title: Four VIP tickets in one add are accepted
testCases.expected: Status 200; VIP quantity 4

testCases.title: Five VIP tickets in one add are refused
testCases.expected: Status 400 'An order may contain at most 4 VIP tickets'

testCases.title: A fifth VIP added to four is refused
testCases.expected: Status 400; VIP quantity stays 4

testCases.title: VIP cap counts all events in the order
testCases.preconditions: Cart with VIP 3 of event A
steps: Add 1 more VIP of event B
testCases.expected: Step 2 returns 200 (4 VIP in total is allowed); step 3 returns 400 "An order may contain at most 4 VIP tickets"

testCases.title: Raising a VIP line above four by PATCH is refused
steps: PATCH the VIP line to quantity 5
testCases.expected: Status 400; quantity stays 4

testCases.title: Checkout refuses an order holding five VIP tickets
testCases.preconditions: Cart holding VIP 5 (only reachable while BUG-08 exists)
testCases.expected: Checkout returns 400; no order created. Clean-up cancels any order created.

testCases.title: WELCOME10 takes 10% off a Standard-only cart
testCases.preconditions: Logged-in buyer with 2 Standard tickets (100,000 each) in the cart
steps: Read the cart totals in the response
testCases.expected: discountCode "WELCOME10"; gross 200,000; discount 20,000; serviceFee 9,000; total 189,000
testCases.notes: Prices below are those of the live "upcoming" event at the time of writing (Standard 100,000, VIP 300,000, Student 50,000); the automated check computes the same figures from the live price with the spec oracle.

testCases.title: Unknown code is refused and totals do not change
testCases.preconditions: Logged-in buyer with 1 Standard ticket (100,000) in the cart
testCases.expected: First call 404 "Discount code not found"; cart discountCode null, discount 0, total 105,000

testCases.title: Applying the same code twice does not discount twice
testCases.preconditions: Logged-in buyer with 2 Standard tickets (100,000 each) and WELCOME10 applied once
testCases.expected: Second apply refused (4xx) or ignored; discountCode "WELCOME10" (once); discount 20,000; total 189,000

testCases.title: Discount does not reduce VIP tickets
testCases.preconditions: Logged-in buyer with 1 VIP ticket (300,000) and nothing else in the cart
testCases.expected: discount 0; serviceFee 15,000; total 315,000
testCases.notes: Prices below are those of the live "upcoming" event at the time of writing (Standard 100,000, VIP 300,000, Student 50,000); the automated check computes the same figures from the live price with the spec oracle. Depends on reading GAP-09.

testCases.title: Discount does not reduce Student tickets
testCases.preconditions: Logged-in buyer with 1 Student ticket (50,000) and nothing else in the cart
testCases.expected: discount 0; serviceFee 2,500; total 52,500
testCases.notes: Prices below are those of the live "upcoming" event at the time of writing (Standard 100,000, VIP 300,000, Student 50,000); the automated check computes the same figures from the live price with the spec oracle. Depends on reading GAP-09.

testCases.title: Mixed cart: discount only on the Standard part
testCases.preconditions: Logged-in buyer with 2 Standard, 1 VIP and 1 Student ticket of the same event in the cart
testCases.expected: gross 550,000; discount 20,000 (10% of the 200,000 Standard part only); serviceFee 26,500; total 556,500
testCases.notes: Prices below are those of the live "upcoming" event at the time of writing (Standard 100,000, VIP 300,000, Student 50,000); the automated check computes the same figures from the live price with the spec oracle.

testCases.title: Service fee is charged on what is left after the discount
testCases.preconditions: Logged-in buyer with 2 Standard tickets (100,000 each) in the cart
testCases.expected: discount 20,000; serviceFee 9,000 (5% of 180,000), not 10,000; total 189,000
testCases.notes: Prices below are those of the live "upcoming" event at the time of writing (Standard 100,000, VIP 300,000, Student 50,000); the automated check computes the same figures from the live price with the spec oracle.

testCases.title: Order confirmation keeps the cart's discount and a single code
testCases.preconditions: Logged-in buyer with 2 Standard tickets (100,000 each) and WELCOME10 applied
steps: Send POST /api/orders with recipient "QA Buyer" and phone "0912345678"
Read the amounts of the returned order
testCases.expected: status CONFIRMED; discountCode "WELCOME10"; grossAmount 200,000; discountAmount 20,000; serviceFeeAmount 9,000; totalAmount 189,000. Clean-up cancels the order.
testCases.notes: Prices below are those of the live "upcoming" event at the time of writing (Standard 100,000, VIP 300,000, Student 50,000); the automated check computes the same figures from the live price with the spec oracle.

testCases.title: Blank code is refused
testCases.expected: 4xx; discountCode null

testCases.title: Discount follows Standard tickets added after the code
testCases.preconditions: Logged-in buyer with an empty cart
testCases.expected: The brief does not say whether a code may be applied to an empty cart. The live site accepts it (step 1 returns 200); given that, step 3 shows discount 20,000, serviceFee 9,000, total 189,000. If step 1 is refused, the check is skipped with that reason.
testCases.notes: Prices below are those of the live "upcoming" event at the time of writing (Standard 100,000, VIP 300,000, Student 50,000); the automated check computes the same figures from the live price with the spec oracle.

testCases.title: Anonymous caller cannot apply a code
testCases.expected: Status 401

testCases.title: UI: applying WELCOME10 in the cart shows the code and the discount line
testCases.preconditions: Logged-in buyer with 2 Standard tickets (100,000 each) in the cart
testCases.expected: Badge reads WELCOME10; Discount line ₫20,000; Service fee line ₫9,000; Total ₫189,000
testCases.notes: Prices below are those of the live "upcoming" event at the time of writing (Standard 100,000, VIP 300,000, Student 50,000); the automated check computes the same figures from the live price with the spec oracle.

testCases.title: UI: after a refused code, applying a valid code leaves no stale error
testCases.preconditions: Logged-in buyer with 1 Standard ticket (100,000) in the cart
testCases.expected: After step 3 an error reading "Discount code not found" is shown; after step 5 no error is shown and the badge reads WELCOME10

testCases.title: Valid checkout confirms the order, empties the cart and takes stock
testCases.expected: Order CONFIRMED with amounts equal to the oracle; cart empty; remaining down by 2. Clean-up cancels.

testCases.title: Checkout of an empty cart is refused
testCases.expected: Status 400 'Your cart is empty'

testCases.title: Recipient of exactly 50 characters is accepted
testCases.expected: Status 200; recipientName stored with all 50 characters. Clean-up cancels.

testCases.title: Recipient of 51 characters is refused
testCases.expected: Status 400; no order created (not silently truncated)

testCases.title: Blank recipient is refused
testCases.expected: Status 400

testCases.title: Checkout phone with 9 digits is refused
testCases.expected: Status 400

testCases.title: Checkout phone without digits is refused
testCases.expected: Status 400

testCases.title: Checkout phone with exactly 10 digits is accepted
testCases.expected: Status 200. Clean-up cancels.

testCases.title: Student ticket without a card number is refused
testCases.expected: Both 400 'A student ticket requires a student card number'

testCases.title: Student ticket with any card value is accepted
testCases.expected: Status 200; studentCardNo stored. Clean-up cancels.

testCases.title: A past event cannot be booked through the API
testCases.preconditions: Fresh buyer; event with status PAST
steps: POST /api/cart/items Standard of the past event
testCases.expected: The add or the checkout is refused; no CONFIRMED order for a past event. Clean-up cancels any order created.

testCases.title: Checkout after the 10 minute hold has lapsed is refused
testCases.expected: Checkout refused until the cart is refreshed

testCases.title: My orders lists only my own orders
testCases.preconditions: Buyer A with one order; buyer B with none
testCases.expected: A sees exactly its order; B sees an empty list

testCases.title: Order detail is readable by its owner
testCases.expected: Status 200 with the same amounts as at checkout

testCases.title: Another customer cannot read my order
testCases.preconditions: Buyer A with an order; buyer B
testCases.expected: Status 403 or 404; no recipient name or phone returned

testCases.title: Another customer cannot cancel my order
testCases.preconditions: Buyer A with an order; buyer B
testCases.expected: B gets 403 or 404; A's order is still CONFIRMED

testCases.title: Another customer cannot change a line in my cart
testCases.preconditions: Buyer A with Standard 2 in the cart; buyer B
testCases.expected: B gets 403 or 404; A's line still has quantity 2

testCases.title: Cancelling more than 24 h before the start refunds 100% and returns stock
testCases.preconditions: Order of Standard 2 for an event starting in more than 24 h
steps: Confirm the event starts more than 24 h from now
testCases.expected: status CANCELLED; refundAmount = totalAmount; remaining back up by 2

testCases.title: A cancelled order cannot be cancelled again
testCases.preconditions: Order of Standard 2 on the quiet event (no other test uses it), already cancelled once
testCases.expected: Second cancel refused (4xx); remaining unchanged

testCases.title: Cancelling after the start refunds 0%
testCases.preconditions: A CONFIRMED order for a PAST event (only reachable while BUG-09 exists)
testCases.expected: Either the cancel is refused (4xx) or refundAmount is 0; never the full total

testCases.title: Cancelling within 24 h of the start refunds 50%
testCases.preconditions: An event starting within the next 24 h
testCases.expected: refundAmount = 50% of totalAmount
testCases.notes: Not executable here (GAP-08): no event starts within 24 h and only an administrator can create one. Kept as a skipped test with that reason, never substituted.

testCases.title: Cancelling an unknown order returns 404
testCases.expected: Status 404

testCases.title: Customer cannot list all orders
testCases.expected: Status 403

testCases.title: Customer cannot export orders as CSV
testCases.expected: Status 403; no CSV body

testCases.title: Customer cannot create an event
steps: POST /api/events with its slug, title, venue and startsAt (a duplicate slug, so a missing guard still could not add a new event)
testCases.expected: Status 403 "Administrator access required"

testCases.title: Customer cannot edit an event
steps: GET /api/events/{id} and keep slug, title, venue and startsAt
PUT /api/events/{id} with exactly those values (changes nothing)
testCases.expected: PUT returns 403; the event is identical before and after

testCases.title: Customer cannot delete an event
steps: DELETE /api/events/999999 (non-existent id, so a defect could not destroy shared data)
testCases.expected: Status 403 (authorisation checked before lookup)

testCases.title: Customer cannot adjust ticket stock
steps: Read the current remaining R of a ticket type
testCases.expected: Status 403

testCases.title: Customer cannot delete an order through the admin route
testCases.expected: 403; order still exists

testCases.title: Anonymous callers get 401 on every admin route
steps: Call each admin route without a cookie
testCases.expected: Every call returns 401

testCases.title: UI: a customer sees no admin navigation and cannot use admin screens
testCases.expected: No admin links; admin screens show no order or event administration data

testCases.title: Smoke: the event list loads
testCases.expected: 10 event cards; total label shows the API total; the past event card shows 'Past'

testCases.title: Smoke: an event detail shows the three ticket types
testCases.expected: Detail shows Standard, Student and VIP with prices

testCases.title: Smoke: register through the UI
testCases.expected: The nav shows the new email (logged in) or the login form accepts the new account

testCases.title: Smoke: log in through the UI
testCases.expected: Nav shows the user email

testCases.title: Smoke: add a Standard ticket and see it priced in the cart
testCases.expected: One line; Service fee line = 5% of price; Total = 105% of price

testCases.title: Smoke: check out through the UI and see the confirmation
testCases.preconditions: Logged-in buyer with Standard 1 in the cart
testCases.expected: Confirmation shows an order id, status CONFIRMED and the oracle total. Clean-up cancels.

testCases.title: Smoke: my orders shows the new order
testCases.expected: The order row with status CONFIRMED and its total

testCases.title: 360 px: a buyer can reach quantity and Add without scrolling sideways
steps: Measure the Standard quantity field and Add button
testCases.expected: Both lie fully inside 0..360 px horizontally and Add can be clicked

testCases.title: 360 px: no buyer screen scrolls sideways
testCases.preconditions: Viewport 360 x 740 mobile; logged-in buyer with a realistic 40-character email address; one cart line
testCases.expected: scrollWidth <= 360 on every screen

testCases.title: Clicking each form label focuses its field
testCases.preconditions: Logged-in buyer with a cart line
steps: On /login, /checkout, /profile, /cart and / click every visible label
testCases.expected: Every form field has a visible label; clicking it focuses exactly that field

testCases.title: Event detail shows the start in Vietnam time
testCases.preconditions: Browser time zone set to Europe/London (not UTC+7); event 2026-10-04T17:30Z
testCases.expected: Start shows 5 Oct 2026, 00:30 (Vietnam), not 2026-10-04

testCases.title: Event list shows starts in Vietnam time
steps: Read the start of each card
testCases.expected: Every card shows the Vietnam date and time of its startsAt

testCases.title: UI search 'rock' shows Hanoi Rock Fest
testCases.expected: A card titled 'Hanoi Rock Fest' is shown

testCases.title: UI sort by name opens with the first event alphabetically
steps: Wait for the sorted list to load
testCases.expected: The ten titles equal the first ten of the whole list in alphabetical order, starting with "Autumn Symphony Night"

testCases.title: Past event shows Past and offers no Add button
testCases.expected: Past label shown; zero Add buttons

testCases.title: Event detail message reflects the latest add
testCases.expected: After step 2 only an error is shown; after step 4 only a success message; after step 6 only the error again, with no "Added to cart" left from step 4

testCases.title: Cancel from My Orders shows CANCELLED and the refund
testCases.preconditions: Buyer with a CONFIRMED order for an event more than 24 h away
testCases.expected: Status CANCELLED; refund equals the total

testCases.title: Cart shows the hold expiry in Vietnam time
testCases.preconditions: Browser time zone Europe/London; cart with one line
testCases.expected: Shows the Vietnam wall-clock time of holdExpiresAt

testCases.title: UI paging shows each event once
testCases.expected: Titles collected equal the total with no repeats

testCases.title: Order confirmation shows every amount in the same currency format
testCases.expected: Both read like '₫210,000'; the total is not shown as a bare number

testCases.title: Smallest discounted cart: one Standard ticket
testCases.preconditions: Logged-in buyer with 1 Standard ticket (100,000) in the cart
testCases.expected: discount 10,000; serviceFee 4,500; total 94,500
testCases.notes: Prices below are those of the live "upcoming" event at the time of writing (Standard 100,000, VIP 300,000, Student 50,000); the automated check computes the same figures from the live price with the spec oracle.

testCases.title: Removing every Standard line takes the discount back to zero
testCases.preconditions: Logged-in buyer with 1 Standard and 1 VIP ticket and WELCOME10 applied
steps: Send PATCH /api/cart/items/{Standard line id} with quantity 0
testCases.expected: Only the VIP line remains; discount 0; serviceFee 15,000; total 315,000
testCases.notes: Prices below are those of the live "upcoming" event at the time of writing (Standard 100,000, VIP 300,000, Student 50,000); the automated check computes the same figures from the live price with the spec oracle.

testCases.title: Discount follows a quantity change on the Standard line
testCases.preconditions: Logged-in buyer with 2 Standard tickets and WELCOME10 applied
testCases.expected: gross 300,000; discount 30,000; serviceFee 13,500; total 283,500
testCases.notes: Prices below are those of the live "upcoming" event at the time of writing (Standard 100,000, VIP 300,000, Student 50,000); the automated check computes the same figures from the live price with the spec oracle.

testCases.title: Next is disabled on the last page of the event list
steps: Click Next until the footer shows the last page
testCases.expected: Next is disabled; the footer never shows a page beyond the page count

testCases.title: Removing the last cart line resets the totals on screen
testCases.preconditions: Logged-in buyer with 1 Standard ticket in the cart
steps: Move focus out of the field
testCases.expected: The cart shows it is empty and no total above ₫0 is displayed

testCases.title: Each cart line shows its ticket type
testCases.preconditions: Logged-in buyer with 1 Standard and 1 VIP ticket of the same event
steps: Read the visible name of each line
testCases.expected: The two lines are visibly different: each name is shown in full (no clipped text) and names its ticket type

testCases.title: A cancelled order offers no Cancel button
steps: Look at the row of the cancelled order
testCases.expected: Status CANCELLED and no 'Cancel tickets' button in that row

testCases.title: 360 px: the menu links can be tapped
steps: Find the element on top at the centre of each of Cart, My orders and Profile
testCases.expected: For each link, the topmost element at its centre is the link itself

testCases.title: 360 px, logged out: Log in in the menu can be tapped
testCases.preconditions: Viewport 360 x 740 mobile; not logged in
steps: Find the element on top at the centre of Log in
testCases.expected: The topmost element at the centre of Log in is the link itself, so a visitor can open the login screen
